headline: Musk proposes Tesla-SpaceX merger as SpaceX revives S&P 500 inclusion push
summary: Elon Musk has proposed a merger between Tesla and SpaceX, creating a corporate entity covering electric vehicles, AI, satellite networks, and space launches. Negotiations are advancing as SpaceX seeks S&P 500 inclusion.
why: Tesla is one of the world's most valuable automakers and a major S&P 500 component, while SpaceX is a leading private aerospace company.
